We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. We have IR spectrum with a peak at 1707 cm-1, typical carbonyl stretch. Need to know if there are multiple carbonyls. Only one carbonyl stretch appears. Could be overlapping but likely one. No other peaks near 1720-1680. So answer integer 1.

But ensure no other data needed. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~200 ppm). Could measure carbon NMR but IR already shows one carbonyl. To be safe, maybe check carbon NMR for carbonyl signals. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
